entities.name: CoaBC candidate
observations: 397-aa sequence has 44% identity to reviewed Haemophilus influenzae CoaBC across 97.2% query coverage (E=3.23e-96); assignment is homology-supported, not direct experimental characterization.
Likely bifunctional enzyme in coenzyme A biosynthesis: phosphopantothenate—cysteine ligase (EC 6.3.2.5) and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase (EC 4.1.1.36).
Reviewed homolog annotations report FMN and Mg2+ cofactors; these are inferred for the query by homology.

entities.name: CoaBC ligation step
observations: Homolog annotation: (R)-4′-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H+ (Rhea RHEA:19397).

entities.name: CoaBC decarboxylation
observations: Homolog annotation: N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + H+ → (R)-4′-phosphopantetheine + CO2 (Rhea RHEA:16793).
